What an atlas's three name columns mean

Source: R/core_contract.R
core_contract.Rd

Every ggseg_atlas keys its core on three columns, and they are not interchangeable.

The two conventions for region

A parcellation that names its structures anatomically gives both hemispheres the same name, so region aggregates them and hemi disambiguates: grouping by region gives one row per structure.

A parcellation that numbers its parcels does not. region_0001 and region_0002 are two different parcels, not one structure seen twice, and no hemisphere-free name exists to recover – the source never gave one. There region is 1:1 with label and grouping by it aggregates nothing.

Both are correct for their source. What was missing was a way to ask which you have, short of testing whether any name is shared across hemispheres. atlas_region_semantics() is that question.
